versions.changelog:
- Initial release of stop-slop-zh
- Provides comprehensive guidelines to eliminate typical AI-generated traces in Chinese writing, such as clichés, formulaic structures, and overuse of abstract or inflated language
- Outlines 9 specific rewriting rules targeting issues like empty modifiers, parallel triads, nominalizations, and abstract subjects
- Includes a 5-dimensional scoring rubric to evaluate writing quality, emphasizing concreteness, rhythm, directness, and human touch
- Offers a practical pre-publication checklist to ensure human-like, readable, and trustworthy Chinese text across various formats (public posts, blogs, docs, emails, etc.)
